authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Local plan boundary dataset describes the area a local plan covers and reports 364 local-plan-boundary records; up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. Official local-plan specification requires a boundary reference/ID, name, Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry and responsible organisation code, providing the exact identifier/polygon evidence required for future-growth coverage binding. However the fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference, local-plan reference/name, LPA/LAD identifier/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any boundary from the register would therefore require guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
